item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Validation API for stage 3.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport math\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Validate and normalize all request rows without modifying inputs.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    errors = []\\n    accepted = []\\n    seen = set()\\n\\n    for index, row in enumerate(request[\\\"rows\\\"]):\\n        if not isinstance(row, dict):\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"id\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        record_id = row.get(\\\"id\\\")\\n        if not isinstance(record_id, str) or not record_id:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"id\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        amount = row.get(\\\"amount\\\")\\n        if (\\n            isinstance(amount, bool)\\n            or not isinstance(amount, (int, float))\\n            or not math.isfinite(amount)\\n            or amount < 0\\n        ):\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"amount\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        unit = row.get(\\\"unit\\\", policy[\\\"base_unit\\\"])\\n        try:\\n            known_unit = unit in policy[\\\"units\\\"]\\n        except TypeError:\\n            known_unit = False\\n        if not known_unit:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"unit\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        if policy.get(\\\"unique\\\", False) and record_id in seen:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"duplicate\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        accepted.append({\\n            \\\"id\\\": record_id,\\n            \\\"amount\\\": amount * policy[\\\"units\\\"][unit],\\n        })\\n        seen.add(record_id)\\n\\n    if errors:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"records\\\": [], \\\"errors\\\": errors}\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"records\\\": accepted, \\\"errors\\\": []}\\n\"}"}
